lines.trans: Wait, we just took a photo together!
Yes, exactly. Even so, I have to ask you to step into my office briefly.
Why on earth? What is going on? Those are my nuts!
No, you stole those nuts right here in the shop.
Sorry, I forgot! I meant to show them at the beginning.
Yes, unfortunately too late. Please come with me.
In such situations, I don't let it come to a flight at all.
If he tries to get past me on the right or left, I grab him straight by the arm.
Then I do a throw-and-roll, for example — it happens super fast.
